notes.title: Gob 1.0.1 released!
notes.content:
Gob v1.0.1 has been released!

The primary purpose of this release is to address some input lag issues on Mac builds and certain setups when a 60hz monitor is being used. This should greatly improve playability of the game.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Gob 1.0 released!
notes.content:
Gob v1.0 is officially live on Steam!

If you experience any issues or bugs, please feel free to report them via this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdX6om8Z7QnArhuci5jL_7HTGtetltLrQAS5i8mJvvlupMKMw/viewform]Google Form[/url].

If you experience any controller issues, you can try temporarily turning off Steam Input for Gob as a workaround while I work to create better Steam controller configurations. The steps to do that are as follows:

[olist]
[*] Right click on "Gob" in your Steam games list
[*] Click "Properties"
[*] Click "CONTROLLER" on the left
[*] Where it says "OVERRIDE FOR GOB" change it to "Disable Steam Input"
[*] Restart the game
[/olist]

Thanks so much for playing Gob and supporting my game development!
